description: A ground-level photograph depicts a landscape characterized by forest damage, featuring numerous standing dead or bare tree trunks with no foliage, interspersed with some stumps and smaller, younger coniferous trees. The foreground is covered with dry, yellow-brown grassy vegetation. In the background, a dense line of trees on a hillside also appears to be heavily damaged or dead, creating a desolate scene under an overcast sky. The image illustrates the "Damaged forest" land cover category, which includes areas affected by pests (like bark-beetle), storm events, or fire, where damage is visible as discolouration of foliage or trees lying on the ground.
